title: Astro doc front matter
description: The front matter of a Markdown or MDX file under docs/. It lists Astro's own keys; add the keys your site reads, each with a description.

title.description: The page title, shown in the heading, the browser tab, and search results.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

keywords.description: Keywords for the keywords meta tag.

image.description: The image shown in link previews: a path or URL.

draft.description: true builds the page in development only and leaves it out of the production build.

unlisted.description: true builds the page but leaves it out of the sidebar, lists, sitemap, and search.

hide_table_of_contents.description: true hides the table of contents beside the page.

toc_min_heading_level.description: The smallest heading level in the table of contents, 2 to 6.

toc_max_heading_level.description: The largest heading level in the table of contents, 2 to 6.

date.description: When the page last changed, such as 2026-10-25.

last_update.description: Overrides the last-updated date and author shown on the page.

id.description: The doc's id, which other docs and the sidebar use; the file name without its number prefix by default.

slug.description: The page's URL path, such as /install, instead of the one from its file path.

sidebar_label.description: A shorter title for the sidebar.

sidebar_position.description: The page's position in an autogenerated sidebar: lower comes first.

sidebar_class_name.description: A CSS class on the page's sidebar item.

sidebar_custom_props.description: Your own values on the page's sidebar item.

sidebar_key.description: A key that keeps two sidebar items with the same label apart.

displayed_sidebar.description: The sidebar shown with the page, or null for none.

hide_title.description: true hides the title heading at the top of the page.

pagination_label.description: The page's title in the previous and next buttons.

pagination_next.description: The id of the doc the next button links to, or null for none.

pagination_prev.description: The id of the doc the previous button links to, or null for none.

parse_number_prefixes.description: false keeps a number prefix such as 01- in the doc's id and URL.

custom_edit_url.description: The "Edit this page" link, or null to hide it.

tags.description: Tags: names, or objects with a label and a permalink.
